description: A very strong thunderstorm downpour in summer in the city courtyard of a residential area. The water pours onto the sidewalks and lawns, and of course onto the metal roof of the canopy, under which I found shelter. The downpour increases at first and eventually weakens. Constant thunderclaps can be heard, which are reflected from tall residential buildings. It is very pleasant to remember the feeling of coolness that this downpour brought after a hot day.
